existing_technologies_and_gaps.technology: RBI MANI App (Mobile Aided Note Identifier)
existing_technologies_and_gaps.intended_purpose: Identify Indian banknotes offline via phone camera for visually impaired citizens.
critical_drawbacks: No Counterfeit Detection: Only scans denomination pattern, completely unable to distinguish genuine notes from fake/counterfeit notes.
Zero Support for Coins: Entirely incapable of identifying ₹1, ₹2, ₹5, ₹10, or ₹20 coins.
Performance Fluctuations: High failure rates in dim Indian lighting, or when notes are soiled, torn, or crumpled.
Struggles with Older Banknotes: Optimized for newer Gandhi series, fails frequently on older circulation currency.
Voice Assistant Search Barrier: Voice triggers often fail because the app is named 'MANI' instead of 'Money'.
existing_technologies_and_gaps.sahaaya_ai_solution: Identifies banknotes AND coins (including 12-sided ₹20 dodecagon); includes tactile security checklist (bleed lines, watermark, color-shifting thread); haptic vibration rhythms tell denomination without audio in noisy markets.

existing_technologies_and_gaps.intended_purpose: Digitize, scan, and read printed and handwritten documents across 12+ Indian regional languages.
existing_technologies_and_gaps.gaps_in_practice: Hardware scanner setup is bulky for daily travel; high institutional pricing limits personal ownership; requires structured educational/library setup.
existing_technologies_and_gaps.sahaaya_ai_solution: Lightweight, zero-cost smartphone web & camera OCR with instant audio readout and automatic classroom comprehension quiz generator.

existing_technologies_and_gaps.intended_purpose: Ultrasonic attachment on white cane detecting chest-to-head obstacles up to 3 meters away.
existing_technologies_and_gaps.gaps_in_practice: Cannot detect drop-offs, potholes, or open storm drains (nalas) beneath ground level; difficult to distinguish overhead electric live wires.
existing_technologies_and_gaps.sahaaya_ai_solution: Safer Journey Companion using real-time computer vision + edge luminosity analysis to detect ground depressions, open nalas, and hanging wires with tactile haptic alarms and emergency GPS SOS.

existing_technologies_and_gaps.intended_purpose: Interactive self-learning Braille hardware device for visually impaired children.
existing_technologies_and_gaps.gaps_in_practice: Priced for institutions and NGO donation programs; unaffordable for low-income rural households in UP/Bihar out-of-pocket.
existing_technologies_and_gaps.sahaaya_ai_solution: Free browser-based screen reader, tactile audio learning, and multi-format lesson delivery for kids on low-cost Android smartphones.

existing_technologies_and_gaps.intended_purpose: Augmentative and Alternative Communication for nonspeaking individuals.
existing_technologies_and_gaps.gaps_in_practice: Prohibitive costs ($100 - $300 subscription); alien cultural icons; lacking Indian languages, colloquial phrases, and local market/transport scenarios.
existing_technologies_and_gaps.sahaaya_ai_solution: Pre-configured Indian AAC board featuring Auto-rickshaw, Kirana/Ration shops, Clinics, and Government offices across 9 Indian languages with 180° flip card view.
